name: every-task-verifiable
prompt: Build me a board. STM32U575 MCU, USB-C for 5V input and USB 2.0 data, a 5V to 3.3V buck plus a filtered analog rail, an ICM-42688-P IMU on SPI, an SHT40 on I2C, a microSD socket on SDIO, one WS2812B LED, a user button, and a Tag-Connect TC2050 footprint. 4-layer JLCPCB, 90 ohm USB pair. 40 x 60 mm with four M2 holes. Use a predefined JLCPCB substrate class rather than a custom stackup.
expected_output: The substrate task still carries a command that runs: a test design importing the predefined class and building. No task in the graph has an empty, absent, or non-executable verification.

assertions.text: the substrate task carries a runnable build command, not a prose excuse. The tracked template offered 'skip if using predefined — no separate file to test', which manufactured a task nobody could check.
every task entry in the template has a Verify line naming the consolidated Python check command, with no exceptions
the Phase 3b audit task's verification is a command plus an outside-voice requirement, not a same-model 'clean' verdict. Both judges flagged the condition-shaped Verify on both cycle-3 samples.
a task's declared dependencies match its real data flow, so a decision owned by a later task is either a declared edge or an open question
assertions.cmd: grep -q 'Check the data flow, not just the declared edges' skills/jitx-project-builder/references/decomposition-guide.md

assertions.text: no task in a produced plan is dispatched as ready while missing a data source or a verification
